title: A standalone Playground for four kinds of generation
summary:
A standalone multimodal Playground joined a more informative model catalog, with new React building blocks and app-specific themes.

Added a Playground app for image, video, text, and audio generation. It loads models through the shared SDK and includes model-specific reference-image limits, video first- and last-frame controls, and audio uploads for transcription. A follow-up updated its app identity for connecting to Enter.

Registry endpoints now provide model categories and display titles, while the SDK catalog includes pricing, context lengths, video capabilities, and reference-media limits. A new React hook loads the public catalog and identifies models allowed by a signed-in key. The README was updated to cover the catalog and React UI additions.

React UI, Playground, Enter, and Model Monitor now have app-owned themes and regenerated icons. React UI and Model Monitor share a new header; Model Monitor also shows a Realtime category and registered models without a corresponding endpoint.

daily.title: Multimodal Playground
daily.text: Try image, video, text, and audio generation in a standalone Playground app. Model-specific controls include reference images, video first and last frames, and audio uploads for transcription.

daily.title: Catalog-aware React apps
daily.text: Use `useModelCatalog` to load the public model catalog without a key and show which models a signed-in key allows. Catalog entries now carry categories, pricing, context lengths, and other model metadata. [Explore the React SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Model capabilities in metadata
daily.text: Model registry responses now include display titles and categories. The SDK catalog also exposes video capabilities and reference-media limits, so apps can set controls per model instead of guessing. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: More React UI building blocks
daily.text: Build generation interfaces with `Typography`, `CodeBlock`, and `MediaPlaceholder`, alongside generation controls under `@pollinations/ui/gen`. [Explore React UI](https://react.pollinations.ai).
